catalog_record.name: Rillmere Valley
catalog_record.climate: Temperate river terraces; warm sunrise, overcast midday and light river mist. Rain is cosmetic until explicitly enabled in fishing rules.
catalog_record.services: Hearthford hub at the river crossing: Mara merchant/quest giver, Tovin trainer, Ilyra bank clerk, Orun smith, Selka cook and Neris fishing contact. Shrine on the dry west bank.
catalog_record.travel: Proposed 45–90 seconds between early objectives, 3–5 minutes hub-to-north-gate on foot and a 7–10 minute optional exploration circuit; time real capsule travel, not map distance alone.
catalog_record.hazards: Shallow ford transitions into a clearly marked deep channel. A broken footbridge has safe banks and a visible return route. No climbing dependency.
catalog_record.arc: First Steps teaches identity and interaction; Road Supplies repairs a warning post; The Sluice Signal reveals old waterworks being disturbed by survey crews.
catalog_record.music: Acoustic strings and restrained low winds; water, woodwork and distant birds. Commission/original or licensed stems, never bundled here.
catalog_record.art: Graybox landscape, ford/bridge, six small service buildings, ore/tree stand-ins, shoreline and water material. Needs separately sourced terrain, foliage, props, buildings and creature sprites.
catalog_record.optimization: One modest graybox map initially; separate town/wilderness actor budgets. Add internal streaming only after measured memory and traversal tests. Zone gates connect separate processes.
tests: Enter every service from spawn without jumping or climbing.
Two players mine OreSite_01 after deterministic selection; one depletes its generation.
One client takes north gate; the other stays in Hearthford.
Fish from both sides of ford; reject cast from deep swimming water.

catalog_record.name: Thornweald
catalog_record.climate: Ancient closed-canopy woodland; dappled light, cool dusk and periodic rain. Maintain readable sprite outlines under canopy.
catalog_record.services: Boughrest trail camp supplies a merchant, healer contact and return shrine. Wardens occupy a ruined boundary tower; no full bank until a later content milestone.
catalog_record.travel: Proposed 4–6 minutes between trail camp and boundary tower, with shortcuts unlocked through exploration rather than mandatory vertical climbing.
catalog_record.hazards: Roots and narrow bridges test stairs/steps and camera occlusion. Hollow trees are interiors, not fully simulated tree destruction.
catalog_record.arc: The Wardens investigate hollow resonators that attract predators; the player chooses a recorded diplomatic response, not an irreversible main-story lock.
catalog_record.music: Sparse bowed strings and branch creaks; distinguish hostile cues from ambient animal calls visually as well as acoustically.
catalog_record.art: Canopy/occluder materials, layered ground cover, bridge meshes, tower kit and three creature sprite families. Phase06 uses only a safe gate courtyard and legal debug placeholders.
catalog_record.optimization: Canopy/foliage culling and simple collision; navigation on authored trails; test relevancy across tree occlusion independently of rendering.
tests: Reciprocal Rillmere gate works with source player left behind.
Tall canopy fades locally without removing server collision.
Navmesh routes enemies across Sevenroot Bridge and leashes safely.
Missing creature animation uses debug presentation without changing hit capsule.
